purpose: Reconcile the pedagogical coverage audit, technical runtime audit, assessment blueprint and readiness policy into one implementation order for a defensible Year 1-3 Recovery product.
decision_rules: The learner's official school recovery programme remains authoritative over the default school-year profile and CEFR defaults.
Renderer or database capability is not pedagogical coverage; an outcome is covered only when suitable content and valid evidence pathways both exist.
Topic completion and topic verification remain supporting evidence and cannot establish year-exit readiness alone.

Development priority and learner-level necessity are different: content that is globally P1/P2 becomes a learner-level P0 blocker whenever that learner's official programme activates the corresponding outcome or axis.
Do not activate Readiness v2 until missing P0 content can actually be assessed and the outcome-evidence runtime can represent the required evidence.
Do not create a second exercise engine; reuse Exercise Builder and extend Recovery scope, metadata, evidence capture and cumulative materialization.

pedagogical_coverage.note: Weighted planning coverage is not a readiness score. No outcome is classified fully covered because cumulative unseen year-exit evidence does not yet exist.

live_topic_layer.note: Wave 1 base bundle files retain older duration metadata, but active production mappings use Verification v2 overlays and total 48 minutes. Production mapping state is authoritative for runtime duration.

readiness.legacy_database_readiness: topic-based weighted readiness with mastery, coverage, assessment and error-stability components
readiness.required_end_state: one canonical server-side Curriculum v2 readiness calculation, shadow-tested before learner-facing cutover

cross_year_prerequisite_alignment.reason: Year 2 was authored in parallel with Year 1 and several progression links were intentionally deferred. Readiness and runtime outcome scoping should consume the corrected dependency graph, not the temporary parallel-authoring graph.
cross_year_prerequisite_alignment.optionality_guard: Do not make a default_core outcome depend on a prior default_if_assessed or programme_dependent outcome.

notes: adverbs-frequency is P1 globally but should be built for a robust Year 1/2 progression.
question-tags currently has no Curriculum v2 outcome reference and should only be authored for a declared school-programme need.
Any programme-dependent grammar item escalates to learner-level P0 if the official school programme requires it.

missing_content_families.deliverable: Approved unseen/transformed fragments tagged with primary axis, outcome IDs, assessment modes, school task family, duration, transfer level and form family.
Fresh mixed grammar, sentence construction, transformation and plausible error-correction forms that do not announce the target rule.

missing_content_families.required_for: grammar plus lexical/writing-supporting outcomes using translation_it_en
missing_content_families.deliverable: Cumulative Italian→English forms mixing systems and accepting all natural level-appropriate variants.
Year-banded lexical domains, chunks and common collocations scored as lexical competence rather than incidental grammar vocabulary.

missing_content_families.required_for: especially upper Year 2 and Year 3 lexical transfer
missing_content_families.deliverable: Contextual collocation, anti-calque, word-family where appropriate, precision and paraphrase evidence.
Year 1 short functional/personal texts; Year 2 connected A2+/early-B1 texts; Year 3 multiparagraph B1 texts with cohesion, inference, attitude and synthesis.
Personal/descriptive paragraph, short message/email and simple narrative with guided-to-independent progression and explicit writing evidence.
Fresh cumulative school forms for mixed grammar, open cloze, transformations, error correction, IT→EN, sentence production, reading, functional text and writing.

missing_content_families.conditional_escalation: P0 when writing is active in the learner's official programme
missing_content_families.deliverable: Email/message, narration, description/explanation, opinion/reasons and B1 revision tasks with independent-writing rubrics.

missing_content_families.conditional_escalation: P0 when relevant writing/revision outcomes are active
missing_content_families.deliverable: Own-text revision evidence covering clarity, cohesion, reference, lexical choice, organisation and essential accuracy.

missing_content_families.conditional_escalation: P0 when the school test requires integrated source-based response
missing_content_families.deliverable: Tasks requiring selection/synthesis of source information before a concise written response.

missing_content_families.conditional_escalation: P0 when listening is active in the official school programme
missing_content_families.deliverable: Stable-audio Year 1-3 progression from short dialogue/monologue to B1 multi-turn and multi-speaker gist/detail/inference tasks.

missing_content_families.conditional_escalation: P0 when functional/oral communication is active in the official school programme
missing_content_families.deliverable: Practical exchanges, follow-up, clarification, repair/reformulation and non-memorised multi-turn interaction.

missing_content_families.conditional_escalation: P0 for learners whose official programme requires the relevant structures
missing_content_families.deliverable: Past Perfect/narrative tenses, Reported Speech and selected B1+ modal/conditional extensions only when required.

completed_foundation: Runtime tables for canonical axes and assessment modes
Runtime table for source-versioned Curriculum v2 outcomes
Assessment-fragment metadata and outcome/mode junction tables

P0_remaining.title: Synchronize the 63 source-controlled outcomes into the runtime catalogue
Derive and persist enrollment required outcomes from the official programme/year fallback
Register approved assessment fragments against outcomes/modes/form families
Upgrade cumulative materialization to choose under-evidenced outcomes and satisfy active-axis coverage within time budget
Capture automatic and manually reviewed fragment results into recovery_outcome_evidence
Implement canonical server-side Readiness v2 in shadow mode
depends_on: enough P0 assessment content to make evidence completeness achievable

implementation_sequence.name: Dependency graph + runtime catalogue
parallel_tracks: Apply cross-year prerequisite recommendations to Year 2/3 source files
Synchronize all 63 corrected outcomes into recovery_curriculum_outcomes
Implement programme/year-profile outcome scoping for enrollments
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Runtime can answer exactly which Curriculum v2 outcomes/axes are required for an enrollment without changing legacy readiness.

implementation_sequence.name: Missing core grammar systems
parallel_tracks: Build and validate the eight P0 grammar topics
Add cumulative-ready metadata planning for the grammar outcomes they support
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Every default-core grammar outcome has its required language-system content available.

implementation_sequence.name: Cumulative transfer engine + first fragment pool
parallel_tracks: Build mixed grammar, IT→EN, sentence production, transformation, error-correction and school-format fragments
Implement assessment-fragment registration
Implement outcome/axis-first materialization
Implement result-to-outcome evidence capture
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Checkpoint and mock sessions can be generated from unseen fragments and record disaggregated Curriculum v2 evidence.

implementation_sequence.name: Core lexical + reading progression
parallel_tracks: Build lexical domains/chunks/collocations progression
Build Year 1-3 primary-axis reading progression
Register alternate cumulative forms for both axes
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Core lexical and reading outcomes can receive independent primary-axis and cumulative evidence.

implementation_sequence.name: Year 1 connected writing
parallel_tracks: Build paragraph, functional message/email and simple narrative progression
Define automatic/manual rubric capture boundaries for independent writing
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: All Year 1 default-core writing outcomes have valid production and cumulative evidence paths.

implementation_sequence.name: Checkpoint/mock completion + shadow Readiness v2
parallel_tracks: Build enough alternate forms for checkpoint, intermediate mock and final mock independence
Activate shadow server-side Readiness v2
Compare legacy and v2 status/gates without changing learner-facing readiness
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: A default written-core profile can accumulate complete evidence and receive a reproducible shadow READY/NOT READY decision.

implementation_sequence.name: Upper-year writing, lexical depth and integrated tasks
parallel_tracks: Year 2/3 connected writing
Self-editing/revision
Paraphrase/lexical precision
Integrated reading-to-writing
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Supported Year 2/3 programmes with writing have complete evidence paths.

implementation_sequence.name: Listening + functional communication
parallel_tracks: Year-banded stable-audio listening
Functional interaction, clarification and repair
Manual oral rubric path before considering automated speaking scoring
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Programmes that assess listening/oral communication can activate those axes without false missing-evidence states.

implementation_sequence.name: Programme-dependent Year 3 grammar depth
parallel_tracks: Past Perfect/narrative tenses
Reported Speech
Selected B1+ modal/conditional systems based on actual school demand
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Declared Year 3 programmes can add advanced requirements without inflating the default profile.

implementation_sequence.name: Readiness v2 learner-facing activation
parallel_tracks: Resolve calibration disagreements
Expose axis/outcome blockers and missing evidence
Switch learner-facing readiness from legacy to the canonical server-side v2 decision
implementation_sequence.exit_condition: Readiness v2 policy activation preconditions are all satisfied and the learner UI never represents product content gaps as learner failure.

readiness_v2_activation_gates: Cross-year prerequisite alignment applied and validated.
All 63 source-controlled outcomes synchronized to runtime.
Enrollment required-outcome scope derives from the official programme with year-profile fallback.
All globally P0 content required for the supported default written-core profile exists and is approved.
Any conditionally required axis/content for a specific supported programme is available before that programme can use v2 readiness.
Assessment fragments can produce valid independent, unseen/mixed and production evidence according to the readiness policy.
Checkpoint and final mock can sample every active blocking axis when feasible.
Outcome evidence capture handles manual responses as pending review rather than zero.
Shadow Readiness v2 has been compared against legacy behavior and calibrated.
Learner-facing reporting can explain status through axis/outcome blockers rather than a single percentage.

first_release_definition.name: Recovery Curriculum v2 written-core release
includes_by_default: Year 1 default-core writing and any writing explicitly required by the school programme
first_release_definition.important_rule: Conditional does not mean optional once the learner's official programme requires it; at that point missing content/evidence blocks READY and the programme should not be advertised as fully supported until the content exists.

next_execution: Seed/synchronize the corrected 63 outcomes into the production runtime catalogue without assigning them to existing learners yet.
Split the eight P0 grammar topics and the first cumulative-fragment pool into parallel content workstreams.
Implement programme-scoped enrollment outcome derivation and outcome evidence capture in parallel with content authoring.
Do not switch learner-facing readiness during these steps.
